integrity: The proof is analytic, with deterministic symbolic and numerical supplementary checks. No external independent review or formal certification has occurred.
limitations: Real two-dimensional normed space only; positive small-skew asymptotic and optimizer orbit, not a global finite-parameter formula or an all-dimensional theorem. The leading zero-skew coefficient has related prior coverage. Literature priority remains independently unverified.
title: Sharp second-order small-skew law for Birkhoff geometry in real \(\ell_4^2\)
